_doc: Terrain textures for geodata maps. tools/pack_terrain_texture.py packs 'textures' (ambientCG CC0, 1K) into assets/terrain/<file>_alb_ht.png / _nrm_rgh.png; tools/terrain_control.py turns the land cover into a Terrain3D control map with 'classes' (land cover class -> texture name); tools/import_geodata_map.gd -- <map> <out> --textures puts both on a map. Texture ids are the list order (Terrain3D ids, max 32).
_doc_rules: blend_sigma_m: how soft the borders between classes are. rock_slope_deg: rock fades in between these slopes. albedo_color: multiplies a texture (above 1 brightens). road_shoulder_m: gravel this far beside roads (under the road meshes and their edges). tint_strength/tint_gain: the land cover colour over the textures (0 = none; the old import used 0.7 / 1.9).
_doc_material: Terrain3DMaterial settings put on the map by --textures: macro variation tints large patches (breaks tiling at a distance); blend_sharpness 0..1 (higher = harder, height-based borders).
_doc_ortho: ortho_tint: with <out>/<file> (geodata/scripts/ortofoto_tint.py, from Lantmäteriet's orthophoto) the import uses it as the colour map instead of the land cover colours and multiplies every texture's albedo_color by 1/neutral_linear (the colour map can only darken, so neutral is encoded at neutral_linear). enabled false = land cover colours as before.
